title: SKY SHIELD
oneLiner: Aim ahead, build chain reactions, and defend six cities through four waves.
mechanics: Aim ahead of incoming missiles and fire interceptors from the selected battery.
Blasts expand, hold and contract; intercepted missiles create smaller chain-reaction blasts.
Each wave has finite ammo and enemy count. Four waves escalate speed, spawn pressure and splitting missiles.
Protect at least one city. Between waves batteries refill and one lost city is rebuilt.
Two players move independent colored cursors and share cities/battery ammo; kills score for the shot owner.

controls.a: Fire an interceptor at your cursor

lose: Every city is destroyed, or the finite overall time limit expires.
scoring: 25 for a direct interception, 50 for a chain interception, plus surviving-city and remaining-ammo bonuses each wave.
note: Original catalogue foundation, no commercial source/assets.
